title: Dashboard (Car / Truck / Bike, Speedboat Helm, Spaceship HUD, Submarine Helm)
layout_order: strip above the panel (right-aligned, wraps onto more lines): X, MINI, HELP, CONTROLS, MAP, INVENTORY, REZ, PANEL, TRIP 0 (not spaceship), KM/H|MPH or KNOTS|KM/H|MPH (boats; none for spaceship), BIKE TRUCK CAR (road designs only); vehicle name + 'values from the vehicle's script' / 'viewer's own model' on the left | panel 1600 x 304 mock with L / C / R anchors (compact two rows when narrow). CAR: wheel (L) | speedometer, rev counter with gear, info screen (fuel, temp, odo, trip, clock), telltales (C) | AUTO/MANUAL, gear stick gate with - +, BRAKE / ACCEL pedals, lamp row < LAMPS HAZ P CRZ HORN > (R). TRUCK: wheel + retarder stalk (AUT, DSC, set speed - +, 0-5, RET lamp) (L) | rev counter with green band, gear screen (A/M, gear, LOW/HIGH, split, RETARDER/DSC, DRIVE, BREAK IN, odo), speedometer with limiter, AIR bar gauge, FUEL / AdBlue bars (C) | gear stick with range collar and splitter, pedals, lamp row (R). BIKE: handlebars (L) | shift lights, bar rev counter, speed, GEAR, lean, fuel, temp, odo, indicator / beam lamps (C) | sequential selector with - +, BRAKE / THROTTLE, lamp row (R). SPEEDBOAT: rev counter, throttle lever F N R, AHEAD / ASTERN | screen: heading tape, HDG, COG, SPEED STEP - +, ON PLANE, DEPTH, TRIM, FUEL, warnings | knots dial, HORN LIGHTS ANCHOR ENGINE. SPACESHIP: speed and throttle tapes, FUEL BOOST SHIELD HULL HEAT bars, heading tape and pitch ladder (or the rocket layout: ALTITUDE, VERTICAL SPEED, APOGEE, STAGE, SEPARATE), word lamps, BOOST ASSIST GEAR ENGINE, altitude readouts. SUBMARINE: depth gauge, BALLAST, PLANES, SEA BED BELOW, DIVE ANGLE, PERISCOPE, sonar scope, BATTERY, OXYGEN, THROTTLE, AHEAD / ASTERN, DIVE SURFACE PERISCOPE PING LIGHTS ENGINE, SAFE DEPTH. MINI: one bar at the bottom. Guide card over the world; resize grip on the top edge.
